origins.neoorigins.water_mage.descriptio: He kaikawe wai e whakahaere ana i ngā ngaru me ngā awa whakaora. I te kāinga i roto i te moana, engari ka maroke i roto i ngā whenua maroke.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_tidal_wave.d: Whakaterehia he kōwae wai ki mua, whakawhiwhia 4 kino me te akiaki i nga hoariri. 5 hēkona whakawera.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_healing_mist: Tukuna he ngaru whakaora e whakahoki mai ana i te 6 HP ki a koe me ngā kaitākaro e tata ana. E 3 mana te utu. 10 hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.name: Ngā kararehe wai
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.desc: Whakatika i raro i te wai mō te wā mutunga kore.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_swim_speed.d: He tere ake te kaukau i te mea noa.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_moisture_reg: Ka āta whakahoutia te hauora i a koe e ruku ana i te wai.
Tangohia te kino i roto i ngā koraha me ngā whenua maroke  te hau maroke e whakaiti i tō kaha.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.name: He ngoikore
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.desc: Whakawhiwhia he 25% iti iho te kino i roto i te whawhai tata.
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.name: Kaihanga ahi
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.description: He kaikauwhau mura e hurihia ana ki te mura  e pupuhi ana i ngā pōro ahi, e pupuhi ana ki roto i te reinga, e tahu ana i te hunga e patu ana i a koe. Kāore e taea e te ahi te whara i a koe, engari ko te wai te whakangaromanga.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.name: Pahupahu
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.desc: Hoʻokomo i kahi hōʻailona o nā pōhaku ahi liʻiliʻi ʻehā i ka nānā ʻana iā ʻoe. ʻE ʻoluʻolu 3 mana. ʻE ʻehā kekona hoʻi.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_inferno_burst: Whakatūwherahia he pupuhi ahi e whakangaro ana i ngā hoariri tata katoa. E 3 mana te utu. E waru hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_flame_cloak.d: Ka riro i ngā kaiwhaiwhai te 30% o te kino e tukuna ana e rātau hei utu ahi.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fire_immunity: He ārai ki te ahi, ki te awa, ki te waikura, e aukati ana i te kino. He wera noa iho te awa.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_water_weaknes: Tangohia 1 kino ia hēkona i te wai, i te ua rānei.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.name: Te oumu ā-roto
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.descri: Ka tere ake te 50% o te matekai i te wera o roto.
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.name: Kaihanga rangi
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.description: He kaiwhakatere rererangi tere e pupuhi ana i nga puhiko hau, e huri ana i te hau o te nekehanga, e eke ana i nga ngaru ki te rangi. He ngawari ano he hau, engari he ngoikore ano he rau.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_wind_charge.de: Whakaarahia he puhiko hau e waihanga ana i tētahi pupuhi i te pānga.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.name: Ko te hau hau
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.desc: Tukua he pupuhi hau e whakaputa ana i tētahi hauwhā i te pānga  ka hiki, ka hiki, ka huri ngā mea e tata ana mō te whā hēkona. 4 mana te utu.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.name: Te rerenga ki runga
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.descri: Whakarewahia koe ki te rangi i runga i te pou hau.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_no_fall_damage: Te Whakatūnga i runga i te Pouaka
Ka ārai te hau i tō hinganga  kāore koe e pāngia e te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.name: Ko te Zephyr
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.descrip: Ka kawea e ngā hau o muri tonu  neke 20% tere ake i te waewae.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.name: Te heke o te pare
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.desc: Me heke āta, me te mea kāore he pānga o te taumaha. Whakamutua mā te kī pūkenga ina hiahia koe ki te heke tere.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.name: Ko te anga pakaru
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.descri: -2 ngā ngākau (-4 HP mōrahi). Kāore he tinana hau i hangaia kia roa.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.name: He ngawari te taumaha
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.descript: Tangohia te 50% atu o te whakahekenga  ka ngāwari rawa te hau ki a koe.
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.name: Te Kaitohutohu Tauhokohoko
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.descript: He kaiwhakatikatika i ngā āpure taumaha e piko ana i te mokowā anō. Tonoa ngā hoariri ki roto i tētahi tūtohu whakangaro, pupuhi rānei i a rātau  engari kāore tō tinana ake i te herea ki te whenua.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.name: He pai te taumaha
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.descr: Whakaoho i tētahi ao pōuri ka taka ki roto i tētahi kōhao pango i te pānga. Ka hopu ngā mea e tata ana ki tōna pokapū, ā, ka pāngia mō te whā hēkona. E 4 mana te utu. 20 hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_repulse.de: Whakatūwhera i tētahi ngaru pānga tōpana e pupuhi ana i ngā mea katoa e tata ana. E 3 mana te utu. E 4 hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_levitation: Ka taea te huri: whakahee i te taumaha me te piki ake i runga i te whakahau (Levitation I).
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_no_fall_da: E kore e taea e koe te tango i te kino o te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_unmoored.d: Tangohia te 75% atu o te whakahekenga  ka māmā te whakarewa i a koe nā tō taumahatanga ngoikore.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.name: He ngoikore
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.desc: Tukuna he 25% iti iho te kino o te whawhai. Ko tō mana kei roto i te hopu, ehara i te wero.
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.name: Kaitohutohu o te Pouri
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.descrip: He kaikawe atarangi e karanga ana i ngā ao atarangi e huri ana, e hikoi ana i waenganui i ngā roto o te pōuri, e huna ana, e whakamate ana i te pō, engari ka tahuna e te rā tō mana.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_or: Whakanohoia tētahi ao atarangi ki tōu wāhi e whakawhiwhi ana i te pōuri me te matapo ki ngā hoariri e tata ana. Tae atu ki ngā ao e toru i te wā kotahi. 3 mana te utu. 5 hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_st: Teleport ki te wahi e titiro ana koe, tae noa ki te 24 wharenui atu. utu 2 mana. 4 hēkona cooldown.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_night_vis: Tirohia mārama i roto i te pōuri katoa. Whakapā atu ki te kī Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_cl: E kitea ana koe e ngā tinihanga i te 40% noa iho o to rātau whānuitanga noa iho.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_sunburn.d: Tangohia 1 kino ia hēkona i te rā tika.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_light_sen: Ko te 30% te puhoi ake  te marama o ngā mata e whara ana e whara ana i ō kanohi.
